subject.title: fix(codex): reduce native hook relay startup latency

question: Does the Codex-hook owner accept the new early CLI dispatch and independently opened read-only state-database boundary as the canonical cold-process relay lifecycle?
rationale: This is a high-leverage internal lifecycle change: tests and the supplied live proof support the performance claim, but choosing the permanent CLI and state-owner boundary requires maintainer intent, especially while the PR is labeled `maintainer`.

options.title: Confirm the isolated client path
options.body: Accept the direct read-only lookup and lazy Gateway fallback after reviewing exact-head equivalence for all stated failure and exit semantics.

options.title: Keep the current lifecycle
options.body: Decline the boundary split if the independent SQLite reader or earlier CLI dispatch is not an acceptable long-term ownership model.

recommendation.title: Confirm the isolated client path
recommendation.body: Accept the direct read-only lookup and lazy Gateway fallback after reviewing exact-head equivalence for all stated failure and exit semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline shows direct notification and subscription for this performance-sensitive Codex change.
